get_guest_codes.name: Get guest codes
get_guest_codes.description: Gets guest PIN codes and live access policy for a SmartRent lock. The response contains sensitive PINs.

create_guest_code.name: Create guest code
create_guest_code.description: Creates a SmartRent-generated guest PIN and returns it only after verified read-back. The response contains a sensitive PIN.

activation_type.name: Activation type
activation_type.description: Whether access is permanent, temporary, or recurring.

phone.name: Phone
phone.description: Guest phone number. Phone or email is required.

email.name: Email
email.description: Guest email address. Phone or email is required.

start_at.name: Starts at
start_at.description: Timezone-aware start timestamp for temporary access.

end_at.name: Ends at
end_at.description: Timezone-aware end timestamp for temporary access.

recurring_start_time.name: Daily start time
recurring_start_time.description: Start time for each recurring access window.

recurring_end_time.name: Daily end time
recurring_end_time.description: End time for each recurring access window.

recurring_days.name: Weekdays
recurring_days.description: Weekdays on which recurring access is active.

update_guest_code.name: Update guest code
update_guest_code.description: Updates guest metadata or schedule and returns a PIN-free result only after verified read-back.

code_id.name: Guest code ID
code_id.description: ID returned by Get guest codes or Create guest code.

activation_type.name: Activation type
activation_type.description: New access type. Omit to preserve the current type.

first_name.name: First name
first_name.description: New guest first name. Omit to preserve it.

last_name.name: Last name
last_name.description: New guest last name. Omit to preserve it.

phone.name: Phone
phone.description: New phone number. Omit to preserve it.

email.name: Email
email.description: New email address. Omit to preserve it.

delete_guest_code.name: Delete guest code
delete_guest_code.description: Deletes a guest code and returns a PIN-free result only after verified read-back.

code_id.name: Guest code ID
code_id.description: ID returned by Get guest codes or Create guest code.
